entries.title: Jeremiah 25:1
segments: ¶The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (which [was] the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:2
segments: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:3
segments: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, this [is] the twenty-third year in which the word of the LORD has come to me; and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you have not listened.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:4
segments: "And the LORD has sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising early and sending [them], but you have not listened nor inclined your ear to hear.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:5
segments: "They said, 'Repent now everyone of his evil way and his evil doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:6
segments: 'Do not go after other gods to serve them and worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands; and I will not harm you.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:7
segments: "Yet you have not listened to Me," says the LORD, "that you might provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:8
segments: ¶"Therefore thus says the LORD of hosts: 'Because you have not heard My words,

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:9
segments: 'behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,' says the LORD, 'and Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and will bring them against this land, against its inhabitants, and against these nations all around, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:10
segments: 'Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:11
segments: 'And this whole land shall be a desolation [and] an astonishment, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:12
segments: 'Then it will come to pass, when seventy years are completed, [that] I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity,' says the LORD; 'and I will make it a perpetual desolation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:13
segments: 'So I will bring on that land all My words which I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied concerning all the nations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:14
segments: '(For many nations and great kings shall be served by them also; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the works of their own hands.)'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:15
segments: ¶For thus says the LORD God of Israel to me: "Take this wine cup of fury from My hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:16
segments: "And they will drink and stagger and go mad because of the sword that I will send among them."

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:17
segments: Then I took the cup from the LORD'S hand, and made all the nations drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:18
segments: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as [it is] this day;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:19
segments: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his princes, and all his people;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:20
segments: all the mixed multitude, all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the land of the Philistines (namely, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod);

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:21
segments: Edom, Moab, and the people of Ammon;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:22
segments: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands which [are] across the sea;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:23
segments: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all [who are] in the farthest corners;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:24
segments: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the mixed multitude who dwell in the desert;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:25
segments: all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:26
segments: all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world which [are] on the face of the earth. Also the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:27
segments: "Therefore you shall say to them, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: "Drink, be drunk, and vomit! Fall and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you."'

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:28
segments: "And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts: "You shall certainly drink!

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:29
segments: "For behold, I begin to bring calamity on the city which is called by My name, and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished, for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth," says the LORD of hosts.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:30
segments: ¶"Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and say to them: 'The LORD will roar from on high, And utter His voice from His holy habitation; He will roar mightily against His fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread [the grapes], Against all the inhabitants of the earth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:31
segments: A noise will come to the ends of the earth-For the LORD has a controversy with the nations; He will plead His case with all flesh. He will give those [who are] wicked to the sword,' says the LORD."

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:32
segments: Thus says the LORD of hosts: "Behold, disaster shall go forth From nation to nation, And a great whirlwind shall be raised up From the farthest parts of the earth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:33
segments: "And at that day the slain of the LORD shall be from [one] end of the earth even to the [other] end of the earth. They shall not be lamented, or gathered, or buried; they shall become refuse on the ground.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:34
segments: "Wail, shepherds, and cry! Roll about [in the ashes], You leaders of the flock! For the days of your slaughter and your dispersions are fulfilled; You shall fall like a precious vessel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:35
segments: And the shepherds will have no way to flee, Nor the leaders of the flock to escape.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:36
segments: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, And a wailing of the leaders to the flock [will be heard]. For the LORD has plundered their pasture,

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:37
segments: And the peaceful dwellings are cut down Because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 25:38
segments: He has left His lair like the lion; For their land is desolate Because of the fierceness of the Oppressor, And because of His fierce anger."
